golden-gate-minimal.note: Recognizable bridge and road detail, but both tower tops and the right approach are cropped.

golden-gate-low.note: The whole span fits. Clear silhouette, though the bridge is small and the mountain backdrop is stylized.

golden-gate-medium.note: Good structural detail and water, but the road and cable approach leave the right edge.

golden-gate-high.note: Complete span with balanced framing and readable tower structure. Landforms are simplified.

golden-gate-xhigh.note: Complete and well-composed bridge, clear suspension structure and coherent shoreline detail.

golden-gate-max.note: Complete bridge and headlands, but the strong haze hides much of the far tower and span.

painted-ladies-minimal.note: Distinctive pastel Victorian row with bay windows. Repeated forms and oversized background towers simplify the setting.

painted-ladies-low.note: Readable colorful Victorian row. Flat staging and close framing weaken the hillside setting.

painted-ladies-medium.note: Well-separated house colors and good row composition; detailing remains schematic.

painted-ladies-high.note: Detailed gables and trim with a full hillside scene. The houses sit a little small under the skyline.

painted-ladies-xhigh.note: Strong roof silhouettes, bay windows, trim and sloping street. Richest readable house geometry in this set.

painted-ladies-max.note: No usable scene was emitted. The 32,000-token response budget was consumed by reasoning.

transamerica-minimal.note: The top is cropped and the broad blank lower body obscures the intended pyramid shape.

transamerica-low.note: Full tower is visible, but window coverage and taper are inaccurate and the tower reads like an obelisk.

transamerica-medium.note: Clear taper and many windows, but the spire is cropped and the surrounding grid is generic.

transamerica-high.note: Full taper, spire and exposed base supports fit well. The windows and fins remain simplified.

transamerica-xhigh.note: Balanced tower silhouette and contextual blocks, though some window rows and side fins are imprecise.

transamerica-max.note: Full city diorama with detailed windows, streets and trees. The main tower remains slightly schematic.

griffith-minimal.note: The scene renders, but the initial camera is obstructed by terrain and the observatory is not visible.

griffith-low.note: Three domes and front terrace are readable. The facade and site are simplified.

griffith-medium.note: Strong domes, staircase and landscape composition with a clear building silhouette.

griffith-high.note: Balanced front view with domes, terrace, landscaping and an unobstructed monument.

griffith-xhigh.note: Good complete building, dome hierarchy and site details. Foreground trees are oversized.

griffith-max.note: Generation reached the token limit with an incomplete script; no rendered scene was produced.

half-dome-minimal.note: Rounded shells and a circular base look like constructed domes instead of a sheer granite cliff.

half-dome-low.note: Shows a flat semicircular slab on a circular base; the black streaks and terrain feel artificial.

half-dome-medium.note: Cliff face is visible, but looks like a thin curved wall and the nearby rounded plates are implausible.

half-dome-high.note: Better sheer granite wall and forest scale, though the rock still resembles a thin slab.

half-dome-xhigh.note: Recognizable cut dome with forest, but floating or overhanging base and rounded background forms weaken realism.

half-dome-max.note: Best rock shading and forest terrain of this set, with a clear cut-dome outline; geometry is still simplified.

santa-monica-minimal.note: Bright pier and rides are readable, but the Ferris wheel top is cropped.

santa-monica-low.note: Complete amusement pier, but wheel supports and projecting spokes are awkward.

santa-monica-medium.note: Complete pier and rides with good separation; the scene is schematic and the wheel is small.

santa-monica-high.note: Readable wheel, roller coaster and timber deck. A few floating dark marks distract.

santa-monica-xhigh.note: Best complete pier composition, coherent rides, shoreline and water detail.

santa-monica-max.note: Full pier and wheel with clear approach; lighting is flat and the coaster is sparse.
